items.topic: This scenario was archived. What is the intended next step — revive it as a standalone scenario, merge its terminal capabilities into an existing scenario (e.g., agent-manager or app-monitor), or keep it archived as a reference for future terminal needs?

Which parent scenarios will embed the web console via iframe, and what authentication/proxy headers do they provide? The PRD references 'authenticated parent scenarios' but does not specify the header contract.

options.label: Any scenario can embed it via a standard Vrooli iframe contract

items.freeform: You don't need to worry about this. As long as packages/api-base is adopted properly, it should all magically work

items.topic: What is the MVP persistence backend for durable sessions and transcripts? The PRD mentions local storage by default with Redis/Postgres as future adapters. Should MVP use flat files, SQLite, or an existing shared resource like the Vrooli Postgres instance?

options.label: SQLite local database (self-contained, no external deps)

items.freeform: redis/postgres should be removed completely from the spec. Only sqlite should be used, per scenarios/prompt-manager/store/skills/packs/core/storage-steer/SKILL.md

items.topic: How important is mobile terminal usage in practice? The PRD includes a P0 floating keyboard toolbar (WC-P0-007), but is this based on actual mobile usage patterns or aspirational? Could mobile toolbar be deferred to P1?

options.label: Mobile is critical — operators actively use phones for terminal access
Mobile is nice-to-have — could defer to P1
Mobile is aspirational — defer to P2

items.topic: For the AI command generation feature (WC-P0-005), what context should be provided to the LLM when generating commands? Should it receive the current terminal output/history, the session working directory, or just the user prompt?

options.label: User prompt + last N lines of terminal output
User prompt + terminal output + working directory + shell environment

items.topic: Should the web console support multiple simultaneous users (multi-tenant), or is it single-user by design since it runs on a personal Vrooli server?
Are there specific performance targets for terminal latency (keystroke-to-display round-trip) or maximum concurrent terminal sessions?

options.label: No specific targets — just feels responsive
